title: Phase-gated auto-apply for Optimize recommendations with operator escrow and traffic-partitioned validation
creator: Evelyn Chen
description: Enable a phase-gated automatic application path for Optimize's batching/caching recommendations that verifies safety and quality before progressing traffic. The flow combines a simulated validation stage, shadow traffic verification, small-traffic phase gates, and an operator escrow step for high-risk changes. The goal is to reduce manual overhead for low-risk recs while providing robust guardrails for anything that affects latency, token-cost, or output fidelity.
acceptance_criteria: A1: New auto-apply flow can accept an Optimize recommendation payload and create a staged rollout config in the rollout-controller
A2: Simulated validation uses synthetic workload and returns a pass/fail for defined golden metrics: p95 latency, error rate, token-cost-per-request, and output-regression score
A3: Shadow verification can run on 100% shadow traffic without impacting production results and produces telemetry in the console (cost, latency, output delta), stored for 7 days
A4: Phase gates support traffic partitions (0%, 1%, 5%, 20%, 100%) with automated progression based on metric thresholds and manual operator escrow at the 5% -> 20% transition for flagged customers
A5: Automatic rollback triggers on threshold breaches and executes the documented revert playbook within 5 minutes of detection
A6: Console shows per-stage telemetry and provides operators an "Approve/Reject" escrow action with audit log entries linked to the rollout
A7: End-to-end integration tests and chaos tests for controller failure/recovery are added and pass in CI
implementation_notes: Core components touched: optimize-service (recommendation enqueuer), rollout-controller (phase gates), serving-runtime adapter (staging flags), console UI (rollout visualization + escrow action), telemetry pipelines
Introduce a 'phase_profile' schema: stages with traffic_pct, min_duration, required_metrics, operator_escrow (boolean), and simulated_check_id
Simulated validation will reuse the existing perf-sled harness (runtime/test-sled) to run model slices; avoid using live customer traffic for simulation to eliminate data-leak risk

Operator escrow is implemented as a latch: when set, automatic progression pauses and requires an operator token (console action or API) to continue; escrow events must contain justification and link to PR/Confluence
Policy enforcement: use OPA policy bundle in rollout-controller to block applies that increase p95 latency by > 15% or token-cost savings < 1% after simulation
For private deployments, provide a local-only escrow hook that integrates with customer SSO/approval flow (configurable via private-deploy.yaml)
Keep default autoapply behavior conservative: only low-impact suggestions (batching thresholds < 2x, or cache TTL decreases <= 30s) are eligible for full-auto; others follow phase-gated with escrow
test_plan: Unit tests for phase_profile parsing and rollout state machine
Integration test: simulate a recommendation, run simulated validation, create rollout, and progress through stages in staging cluster
E2E smoke: apply a harmless cache-ttl reduction on staging, validate zero user-visible regressions and telemetry emitted
Chaos: kill rollout-controller during a stage progression and verify safe rollback path and resumed state after recovery
Load test: verify that shadow verification at 100% traffic does not add >2% latency to serving (~observed baseline)
Regression test: ensure that OPA policy prevents a blocked recommendation from being auto-applied
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (simulated): run perf-sled against recommended config; pass required_metrics to create rollout
Phase 1 (shadow 100%): deploy changes in shadow mode for 24h, collect token-cost and output-delta metrics
Phase 2 (live 1%): partition 1% of traffic for 4h; require metric thresholds met (p95 within 10%, error rate increase <0.1%, output-regression <0.5%)
Phase 3 (live 5%): operator escrow check required for customers tagged 'enterprise' or if cost savings >10%; hold for manual 'Approve' or wait 12h for automated continuation if escrow not required
Phase 4 (20% then 100%): automated progression if thresholds held for min_duration; automatic rollback if breach detected
Fallback: if any stage fails, immediately revert to previous config and file incident with rollback reasoning. Send notifications to #ops and responsible PM/SEMs
